rationale: Mandatory national e-procurement portal — primary, highest-density A2 source for Kosovo.
Id-addressable notice endpoint of the e-Prokurimi portal; a fetch pattern, not a standalone source.
Documented OCDS API with award/party/tender filters — the best machine-readable collection channel.
Public OCP mirror with bulk JSONL/CSV backfill 2016-2026; cheap history without hammering the portal.
Regulator site publishing rules, forms, blacklists — durable actor-map and rule-change feed.
Single annual-report PDF; useful market-structure context but a one-off artifact.
Static trilingual rulebook PDF — mine once for terminology/thresholds, not a recurring signal.
Central purchasing body whose framework contracts absorb cross-government payments/cash lots.
Review body decisions annul or reshape awards and expose bidders/pricing — early-warning feed.
NGO mirror of OSHP decisions, easier to query; useful cross-check on official completeness.
Civil-society aggregator normalising awards since 2010; strong supplier-side view and parsing validation.
Red-flag analytics on the same PPRC data; flags non-competitive banking/payments segments.
Central bank's own tenders page — most domain-relevant buyer, publishes outside the central platform.
Buyer-side shared PDF folder, verification failed; probe once as a fallback retrieval route.
Municipal republication of e-Prokurimi notices — redundant with the portal unless local coverage gaps appear.
National Audit Office reports name contracts and reveal unnoticed awards; recurring publisher.
BIRN investigative tag pages give sustained procurement coverage and documents not otherwise online.
Descriptive multilateral regime page, unverified URL; low incremental value over the national sources.
One-off transparency rating page; informs feed-completeness assumptions but rarely updates. URL unverified.
Ecosystem case study — mine once for snowball leads into the Kosovo OCDS consumer network.
Paywalled commercial resellers with unknown latency/coverage; redundant to the official OCDS feed.
IO buyer outside the national PPL closes a census gap, but page verification failed — recheck liveness.
BQK's own procurement rulebook PDF — decides whether BQK lots ever reach e-Prokurimi; scoping evidence.
